html: † I. [דָּגַל] vb. look, behold (Assyrian dagâlu, LotzTP 131; Thes RobGes MV SS De make דָּגוּל a denom. from דֶּגֶל = lifted up like a banner, or furnished with a banner, i.e. exalted, distinguished, AV RV chiefest);—Pt. pass. דָּגוּל מֵרְבָבָה Ct 5:10 looked at, conspicuous, according to DlHA 40.
